notes:
Manuscript p. 1; separate bottom pencil 2. Defines isotopy classes of finite étale maps of oriented finite-type topological surfaces, with “respectant l’orientation” cancelled. Connectedness “pour simplifier” and path-connectedness “par arcs” are inserted. Isotopy is expressed by a finite étale F over I=[0,1] with prescribed endpoints, followed by a product trivialization via a covering Y′ of Y.

The words after continue read fin étal, not H’s famille. This matters because continuity of an arbitrary family alone is not the stated finite-covering condition. The source says the product functor is “pl. fidèle” and then infers existence and uniqueness. Full faithfulness alone gives uniqueness, not essential surjectivity; existence uses the additional fact that a cover over Y×I is a product up to isomorphism. No word is inserted into the transcription to repair this compressed argument. The feminine “une homéom.” and the shorthand “la = application” remain as written.

checks.statement: Full faithfulness alone implies existence of Y-prime for a given cover F.
checks.outcome: The inference needs essential surjectivity in addition to full faithfulness. A full embedding of a proper full subcategory is a counterexample to that inference in general. Refined statement: 142-003-EQUIV.
